 Torino vs Monza Prediction, 10/25/2026 Soccer Pick, Tips and Odds
 by Guy Bruhn - 10/20/2026 
 Game: Torino vs Monza
 Date: Sunday, October 25, 2026
 Location: Stadio Olimpico Grande Torino in Torino, Italy
 TV: Paramount+, DAZN
 The White and Reds (2-1-4) are headed to Stadio Olimpico Grande Torino in Torino, Italy on Sunday where they will take on Torino (3-1-3). The Maroons are priced at -144 while the White and Reds are at +120. The total comes in at 3. The men protecting the net are Lucas Perri for Torino and Noel Tornqvist for Monza.
 Torino has recorded 22 saves and also have a save rate of 71.0% this season. Their goal differential is currently at 1 because of 10 goals scored and 9 goals surrendered. The Maroons sit at 5th concerning expected goals having 21.6, and the squad's xGA are at 22.0. Torino has tallied 6 yellow card warnings on the campaign. The Maroons have relinquished 9 goals while giving up 1.29 goals per 90, and the opposition have amassed 31 shots on target on them. They have accumulated 1 clean sheet, which puts them at a rate of 14.3% on the campaign. Over the course of the season, the team sports an average of 1.43 points per fixture (10 pts) and also have a ranking of 12th in European soccer with 7 assists.

 The White and Reds have an average of 1.0 pts/match while accumulating 10 assists and 1 red card. Monza ranks 17th concerning goals conceded having 15, and the team's goal difference is sitting at -2. A.C. Monza has accumulated a shut out % of 14.3% for the year and also 11 yellow card warnings. For the year, A.C. Monza has a save % of 58.3% (36 SoTA), and also rank 14th in Big 5 soccer with 7 pts. Their goals against/90 min is at 2.14 in addition to 21 saves, and they have earned 1 clean sheet. Monza has earned 13 goals and this team's goals expected so far this season sits at 20.8.
 The guy who is expected to defend the goal for Torino will be Lucas Perri. Perri has seen the field for a total of 13,371 mins and has tallied 465 saves during his soccer career. Perri (62-40-45 mark during his career) has earned 46 clean sheets, which leaves him with a 31.0%% shutout rate. The goalie born in Brazil has seen 641 shots attempted at him in 147 career starting assignments. His goals against per 90 minutes is 1.18 (176 goals allowed) and he is the owner of a save percentage of 72.5%.
 Noel Tornqvist is expected to look after the net for Monza. In his career, Tornqvist has given up 83 goals and has 246 stops in 97 starts. Tornqvist has racked up 32 shutouts and defended 329 shots tried against him in 8,635 mins in his career. He has earned a save % of 74.8% and his clean sheet rate sits at 33.4%%. He has surrendered 0.87 goals per 90 minutes while holding a mark of 52-20-25.
 Duvan Zapata is a member of the side who can be a force on the pitch for Torino. He has 55 assists while tallying 343 points so far in his career. The forward from Colombia has totaled 144 goals scored in 26,377 mins played. Zapata has had a starting assignment in 298 outings so far in his career and he scores 0.49 goals per 90.
 Monza has an attacker in Patrick Cutrone, who should keep defenses up at night. He currently averages 0.37 goals per 90 mins and has been a starter in 191 matches during his pro soccer career. The forward representing Italy has totaled 17,366 mins and has earned 72 goals. He has accumulated 164 pts thus far in his career and has helped on a goal 20 times.
 Who will win tonight's soccer game against the spread? 
 Guy Bruhn's Pick: Take Torino (+120)
